title: Conveyor Engineer
company: JSW MG Motor India Pvt Ltd
description:
Role & responsibilities 1. Floor conveyor, Overhead conveyer, Car Body Handling System Planning, feasibility Study for new product, Technical Bid Package Preparation, Bids Evaluations, Scheduling , Project Execution, Buyoff , Billing & Contract Closure. 2. Implementation of Body, Paint & GA Shop Conveyor and Rail & Hoist System. 3. Estimation and Costing for New Conveyer System New Product Program & modification in existing conveyor system. 4. Conveyer Side MPS Preparation, Estimation planning & Project scheduling 5. Project Management Capex Budget for CCR Function. 6. Design Review with Contractor & Approving the Design as per MG Conveyer Standards. 7. Develop Standard Specification for New Conveyer System and Continuous Improvement. 8. Modification of existing Conveyer System, Body handling equipment hangers, Trolleys . 9. Implementation of MG Conveyer Standards & GDHS 10. Implementation of safety process & standards as MGI requirements. Work closely with the overseas counterparts and shop Manufacturing Engineer at MGI Halol. 
 Preferred candidate profile Good experience in Conveyer System (floor and overhead), Rail & hoist system load calculation and lay-outing, conveyor type selection Good skill in Conveyer System specification design & type of components selection. Hands on experience of Installation & commissioning of new conveyor system. Experience in Hanger and body trolley modification to accommodate new models/ new projects Experience in conveyor standards development, Estimation and Costing of conveyor system Project Management Basic Knowledge of Electrical & Control System for Conveyer Interlock Hands on experience on CAD, UG and MS project software

Key Skills: Mechanical,Conveyors
